ABOUT.Description: My name is Owen, I'm 22 years old, and I'm studying computer science at ESIEA, an engineering school. My interest in computers goes back to my childhood, when I discovered video games. Since then, my passion for this field has continued to grow. I love exploring new technologies and learning new skills.

2020-2021.Title: Past
2020-2021.Description: I attended a general high school with a technological specialization (STI2D). During this period, I worked on several IoT projects using Arduino boards.

2023-2025.Title: Past
2023-2025.Description: I studied at Paris Cité University, where I completed the first year of my Bachelor's degree in technology. I worked on multiple academic projects in software and system development.

2026-2028.Title: Present
2026-2028.Description: I am currently enrolled in an engineering school while working as a Full Stack Developer apprentice at Subsea7. I contribute to various internal web application projects and continue to develop my technical skills.

2029.Title: Future
2029.Description: I aim to solidify my expertise in cloud technologies, DevOps practices, and scalable architectures. My goal is to take on more responsibilities in software engineering, possibly moving toward a DevOps or Cloud Engineer role.

SKILLS.Subtitle: My Skills
SKILLS.Description: During those years in development, I did several projects. For each project, I used a different programming language and utilized GitHub to learn new technologies. You can find these projects on my GitHub profile.
SKILLS.CSharp: I implemented the backend with C# and developed REST APIs, utilizing Swagger for documentation.
SKILLS.Angular: I did several Angular projects in a company to develop new solutions. I also did this portfolio with Angular.
SKILLS.AzureDevOps: Using Azure and AzureDevOps to create CI/CD pipelines during my apprenticeship.
SKILLS.Java: We created java projects given by our university available on Github.
SKILLS.Flutter: I have developed a mobile application tailored for reporting medications.
SKILLS.CPlusPlus: My first project in C++, which helped me understand the logic of coding.
SKILLS.Git: I am using git and github to put the various projects I've done.
SKILLS.Firebase: We opted for Firebase as the database for our mobile application, developed in Flutter.

WORK.Subtitle: My Work
WORK.Description: A mix of personal tools and school work — the projects that actually moved me forward. Useful utilities, apps, and algorithms, all on GitHub.
WORK.ProjectRedesignDesc: University brief: pick a French town site and make it clearer and more modern without losing its identity. A good exercise in UI under real constraints.
WORK.ProjectGraphsDesc: Dijkstra on several graph types, with a real focus on performance — shortest path even when the graph gets huge. Slightly nerdy, fully intended.
WORK.ProjectMastermindDesc: Classic Mastermind rebuilt in VB.NET for class: a secret code, clues, and a lot of logic. The first game I actually shipped end to end.
WORK.ProjectMobileAppDesc: Flutter app (iOS + Android) for pharmaceutical reporting. Auth, Firebase sync, and a flow built to be fast in the field — more product than homework.
WORK.NamiFlowDesc: File transfer with an extra security layer: every file is scanned through the VirusTotal API before it is sent. A personal tool to mix C# with a real third-party API.
WORK.FolderCompareDesc: Small C# utility: two paths, a scan, diffs in Excel, and an email at the end. Born from a real need — comparing trees without doing it by hand.
